_help: Admin settings for the site's colour. Ask Claude to change them. Colours are the 36 ids in palettes.json (one per 10 degrees of the colour wheel). schedule: fixed = always 'fixed'; weekly or monthly = go round the 'rotation' list of that audience, one step per week or month, counting from 'start' (use a Monday for weekly, the 1st for monthly). Dates change at midnight India time.
